batting.name: Mohammad Nabi
batting.dismissal: c Anuj Rawat b Mustafizur Rahman

batting.name: Rashid Khan
batting.dismissal: c CH Morris b Mustafizur Rahman

balls.text: Miller closes out the innings with a six over extra-cover. Pitched up and outside off, slot ball from Vijay. Miller leans into it and utterly batters it over the off side
decent line and length from Vijay. Back of a length and outside off, hauled away to long-on
dug in short and wide of off, plinked to Pandey at long-off. Parag comes back for the second
just short of a yorker length on off, Miller swings for the hills and ends up slicing it off the outer half to Khaleel at deep backward point
back of a length cutter, wide of off, finishes inside the tramline. Miller swishes and misses in the channel
he hits a hard length and goes wide of off, edged behind past the right of Bairstow
fullish and outside off, Buttler has a slog at it and plays it on. No celebrations from Sandeep or Bairstow. Parag punches Butter's gloves and sends him off. Top innings from a top white-ball batter

Outrageous hitting from Buttler. Dug in short and wide of off. It might have been an off-side wide had he missed it. He reaches out for the free-hit with his hands and flat-bats it powerfully over extra-cover for another six
wide of the crease, half-volley on off stump. Buttler camps in the crease once again and muscles it over long-on for six. Ooops, the no-ball siren goes off. SRH are cracking under pressure
rifled away to the right of sweeper cover. Short and very wide of off. Buttler does well to reach the ball. He does even better to find the boundary
better from Sandeep. Banged in shorter and outside off, beats Buttler's leg-side slog
pitched up and outside off, right in Buttler's swinging arc. Poor length from Sandeep. The batter sits deep in the crease and shanks it over long-off
just short of a yorker length on off stump, Parag clears his front leg and hauls the ball to long-on
low full-toss outside off, belted back to the bowler with so much force that it bursts out of Bhuvneshwar's hands. Very difficult return catch. This one doesn't stick
yorker on middle, squeezed down to the right of long-on
Parag clears the long-on boundary. Sure, it was a slot ball outside off, but Parag swings lustily
middle-stump yorker, forced past the bowler
on a length and wobbles away past the tramline, off-side wide
another excellent yorker outside off, squirted down to long-on
inswinging yorker on middle and leg, whisked away to deep midwicket

back-of-a-length offcutter, 113ks, cramps Buttler for room. Stabbed into the leg side off the inner half. Maiden T20 century for Buttler. He takes his helmet off, raises his bat, and soaks in the applause from the RR dug-out
short and wide of off. Buttler reaches out for the ball and brings his fast hands into play, scything a cut past sweeper cover for four

Samad shows his team-mates how to take the pressure catches. He snags it at the edge of the long-off boundary. Good overhead catch. Fullish and wide of off. Vijay takes it away from Samson's swinging arc. The batter looks to pump it through the line, but can only slice it off the bottom part
Vijay aims for the yorker, comes out as a wild full-toss down the leg side. Bairstow tumbles to his left to stop the ball
just short of the yorker length and outside off, Buttler has a big swipe to the leg side and inside-edges it past the left of Bairstow
quicker bouncer from Vijay at 131ks, Samson searches for the ramp, but ends up gloving it just over Bairstow. Vijay has his hands on his head
off-side wide as this slower ball goes wrong for Vijay
starts off with a 122ks cutter wide of off, inside-edged behind to the keeper
fullish and outside off, driven down to long-on
short and Bhuvneshwar takes another slower one away from Buttler. Carved to Vijay at sweeper
off-stump yorker, jammed wide of long-on for a double
on a length and outside off, another slower ball from Bhuvneshwar. Buttler swipes to the leg side and sends an outside edge flying over short third man
off-stump yorker, the ball rolls through midwicket off the inner half
slower ball from Bhuvneshwar. Short and well wide of off, with no protection in the deep at third man. Sliced away for four
back of a length and straightens along a middle-stump line. Buttler pulls and sends the ball soaring over square leg. Nabi and Vijay have conceded a combined 39 from 2 overs
belted away straight of long-off. Comes out too full on off, Buttler gets underneath the length and smashes it down the ground
back of a length and sliding across off at 99ks, inside-edged back towards Nabi
drilled away to the left of Pandey at long-on. Flatter, faster, fuller, powered down the ground
Nabi searches for that hard length, but digs it shorter and just a shade outside off. Buttler jumps onto the back foot and carts it over long-on for six
flat and quick on middle, short in length, pulled away to deep midwicket
banged in short and wide, Khaleel cranks it up to 147.3ks, Buttler swishes and misses in the channel
shovelled with the bottom wrist over wide long-on for six. On a fuller side of a good length and angling in towards off, Buttler takes a step back and launches it away
slower ball around off stump, dinked between backward point and short third man
full and wide of off, seam-up ball, Samson latches onto the width and slices it off the outer half over short third man
back of a length and outside off, heaved away between deep midwicket and wide long-on
cutter, sliced away to the left of Jadhav at backward point
yorker outside off, dug out to point. 17 off the over
back of a length and wide of off, slapped away to the right of Nabi sweeping the off-side bondary
banged in short and wide of off. Buttler leaps to get on top of the bounce. Flat-batted away over extra-cover. Swung away over the infield, tennis-style
goes for the wide yorker but darts it past the tramline. Off-side wide
muscled to the right of long-on. On a length and outside off, slot ball from Sandeep. Buttler sizes it up and clouts it down the ground
bouncer outside off, Buttler splices it over midwicket off a top edge
wide of the crease, just short of a yorker length, stabbed out to extra-cover, where Williamson lets it burst through his hands
seam-up, on a length and well wide of off. Buttler spars at it and misses outside off
another cutter attempted by Khaleel. Buttler, having shuffled across off, waits for it briefly and then scoops it over Bairstow's head. With third man and fine leg up, that shot was on
back of a length and holds its line outside off, patted to point with an open face
Samson steps out at Khaleel and yorks himself. This ball squeezes underneath his bat
slower offcutter. Shortish and outside off. Hauled to long-on
back of a length and sliding into off stump, Buttler pulls weakly to the right of deep square leg
wrong'un, on a back of a length, Buttler shifts back and turns it though the leg side
whipped off the pads to deep square leg
back of a length and finishes on the pads, glanced to Khaleel at short fine leg
wrong'un, skidding into middle, clipped through the leg side
down the track and hauled away straight of Pandey at long-on. Tossed up slower and higher outside off, Samson reaps reward for attacking intent
Buttler plays back to this full ball and nurdles it through the vacant spaces at midwicket
Samson feigns to shift outside leg, he has to get back in line as Sandeep nails an off-stump yorker. Dug out
slower ball. Short and wide of off, slapped away to the left of Vijay at sweeper
Samson ventures down the track, meets a full ball early outside off and laces it to Vijay at sweeper cover
Sandeep tries to hit the blockhole outside off. Just short of a yorker length, carved to point
off-side wide

Dropped at long-off, this time by Pandey. Wide of the crease, full and wobbles away outside off. Samson hits it straight to the outfielder. Pandey snatches at the ball and shells it. "It was going alright until I saw that [drop]," says coach Bayliss
short, wide. Cracked off the back foot to Vijay at sweeper
shorter and spinning away outside off, flayed to Bhuvneshwar at sweeper cover off the back foot
fuller and sliding into middle and leg, tucked through square leg
another googly? Finishes on the pads, deflected behind square
googly from Rashid, Buttler miscues a reverse-sweep, but does not carry to point or short third man
Buttler stays leg-side of this legbreak and stabs it to point. He is keen to turn over the strike, but has to undo his steps
on a length and spins away quickly outside off, Samson punches through the line to sweeper cover
slower ball, on a length and outside off, Buttler aims to pierce the gap between short third man and backward point now. Instead, he hits it straight to backward point
Samson jumps on top of his short ball outside off and punches strongly to sweeper cover
change-up from Khaleel. Offcutter, but it's short and wide of off. Samson delays the cut and guides it deftly between short third man and backward point
worked through the vacant spaces at midwicket with the incoming angle. Samson comes back for the second
Samson closes the bat-face early and plops a leading edge to the left of Khaleel and right of short extra-cover
back of a length and angling into middle from round the wicket, played back to Khaleel's right
bunted with the angle through square leg. Vijay has leaked 18 from his first over
launched over long-off for a towering six. Length and outside off, slot ball from Vijay. Samson extends his arms and lofts it through the line
Vijay pushes this fuller one past the tramline. Off-side wide
full and wide once again, Buttler chucks his hands at the ball, slashing to sweeper cover
full and wide of Buttler's swinging arc. Squeezed straight to Williamson at short extra-cover
slides a slower offcutter down the leg side, wide
short-armed over midwicket for six. Fractionally short and outside off, hip-high delivery. Buttler camps back and wallops it over the leg side
into the pitch, back of a length and outside off, Buttler opens the bat-face and steers it away to the left of sweeper cover
on a length and nips away just enough to beat the outside edge
Samson rides the bounce of this back of a length ball outside off and guides it to short third man
clipped wide of midwicket
too full and straight, firmly flicked away through midwicket. Wide of Vijay Shankar, the leg-side sweeper
hint of outswing for Bhuvneshwar, beats the outside edge
full on the pads with fine leg inside the circle, glanced away fine of that infielder for four

Vijay Shankar misjudges a catch at long-on. It could've been two in two for Rashid. Buttler steps out to Rashid, but does not meet the pitch. He hauls it in the air. The ball dips at Vijay in the outfield. Vijay was in a dilemma whether to attack the ball or hang back and take it on the bounce. He's eventually late to put in a dive. He goes for the catch with both hands, but the ball bounces just in front of him. He was in no position to take it
Buttler goes for another reverse-sweep, he ends up shovelling it past slip

Buttler aims for the reverse-sweep....and misses. Not given out lbw. SRH don't have a review left. Flat and quick once again, wrong'un, Buttler goes low and wears it on his back leg. That looked close as well. Okay, the tracker reckons that would've hit leg stump. Three reds
Rashid drags his length back and gets it to angle in outside off, swatted away to wide long-on
Buttler shimmies out and drives down to long-on
Samson shuffles across off, Rashid follows him with the slider, deflected through square leg
slower-ball cutter from Khaleel, Buttler drives early and misses this offcutter
banged in short and aimed at the chest, on the stumps, fended back to Khaleel

very full and very wide of off stump, sliced away in the air to the left of sweeper cover. Rashid slides to his left at the boundary and tries to haul the ball into play. But his lower body is in contact with the ad board while doing so
on a heavy length and slanting away from Samson again, but closer to off, he drags a pull through the leg side
first-ball six for Samson! On a back of a length and angling away just a shade outside off, Samson plants his front leg and shanks it against the angle over midwicket for six
short and angling across off stump, Buttler camps back and slaps it to sweeper cover

this is much closer, and umpire Gaffney raises his finger. Jasiwal has a chat with Buttler and walks off. Slider from Rashid, fizzes in to ping the pad bang in front of middle. Jaiswal is beaten for both length and pace. He plays back to it and doesn't put bat on ball once again
floated fuller and outside off, driven more or less straight to extra-cover now
seems like the wrong'un from Rashid. But he drops it short and outside off. Jaiswal jumps back and cuts it firmly to the right of extra-cover
fizzing legbreak, Rashid brings this back into Jaiswal, glanced away fine past the keeper for four

Jaiswal stretches out for another sweep, but this is too full for that stroke. It dips into middle, Jaiswal can't put bat on ball. Not given out lbw, Williamson calls for a review. Ultra Edge detects no spike. Just a flat line on it. Is that threatening the stumps? Ball-tracking suggests it would've missed off stump. Good call from umpire Gaffney. He has a smile on his face
pushed through full on middle, Jaiswal stretches out and rolls out a sweep. He hits it over square leg
full on middle stump. Nudged off his pads to mid on
fullish, wider outside off. Slashes hard at it, and gets it over the infield. Deep point runs across to clean up
length ball outside off. Angling away slightly. Mistimes the cut to the off side
full on middle. Driven, to Williamson at cover
full on middle and leg. Flicked to the on side, and enough time to take the second
full on middle. Drives off the front foot, but mistimed due to the ball moving away from the left-hander. Finds mid off
full, outside off. Buttler gets behind the ball, and defends to mid off
good length, on middle. Flicked, off his waist, to deep backward square leg. A jogging single for YJ
fullish, on off. Tentatively defended, and the ball rolls away to point
fullish, on middle. Buttler shuffles across and flicks this onto his pads, and the ball rolls away to midwicket. An early call for one
fuller, on off stump. A check drive back to the bowler off the front foot
one slip in place, but a length ball on off. Defended off the back foot to the off side. A little bit of shape
Sakariya finishes it with an accurate yorker, dug out for one
back of a length on middle, leading-edged into the off side
back of a length on middle and leg, another slower ball, which is knocked away to the right of long-on
lifter outside off, gets big on Bhuvneshwar, but he manages to fence it away between backward point and short third man for four
another slower cutter, which is nicked to the right of Samson. Good save from the keeper
Bhuvneshwar slogs at this slower one outside off and misses
back of a length and outside off, this slower ball is dabbed to backward point
Bhuvneshwar rides the bounce of this short ball outside off and glides a four between backward point and short third man
backs away outside leg and drives to long-off from a middle-stump line
back of a length and angling into leg stump, miscued to long-on
Sandeep backs away outside leg, Morris chases the moving batsman and keeps him to a single to long-on
slower ball, full and dips on middle stump, flicked through midwicket
on-pace yorker on off stump, toe-ended away between the keeper and short third man for four. Mustafizur has a wry smile on his face
swing and a miss to another offcutter outside off
full and outside off, driven to the left of extra-cover
off-stump yorker, squeezed down the ground
Mustafizur rolls out another offcutter. He now has Rashid holing out to long-off.  It was too full, but the lack of pace does Rashid in. He slogs and slices it to Morris
slower offcutter dips outside off, Rashid forces it straight to extra-cover
darted past the tramline, off-side wide
Jadhav plays back and is castled. On-pace full ball, nips into middle. Jadhav slogs and misses. Morris hits the middle stump
lifter outside off, Morris beats Jadhav on the hook
low full-toss outside off, drilled more or less straight to extra-cover

Rawat runs back and holds onto his third catch even as the ball swirls away from his reach. He runs back from extra-cover and takes it over his shoulder before diving into the ground. Slower cutter outside off, Samad can only sky it to the debutant
wide yorker, finishes inside the tramline, no shot
off-side wide
just short of a good length and outside off, Jadhav slogs it away to deep midwicket
slower cutter outside off, guided to point. Fine comeback from Sakariya after that first-ball six
off-stump yorker, squeezed to long-on
full and wide of off, Samad swings and misses in the channel
low full-toss on the stumps, wafted back to the bowler
just over extra-cover. Low full-toss outside off from round the wicket, sliced over the infielder
floats a slower ball past the tramline, off-side wide
Samad smites a big six over midwicket. Short and outside off, may have been a slower ball. Samad gets hold of it
closes out the over with another cutter, this is shorter, and Jadhav can only inside-edge it onto his pad
Mustafizur rolls out one cutter after another, this is patted through the covers
down the track and hacks a full-toss to long-on
full and wide of off, another cutter, which is sliced past keeper to short third man
offcutter at 119.2ks outside off, sliced straight to extra-cover. Whippy change-up from Mustafizur, Nabi looks to loft down the ground. Instead, he miscues it to Rawat again
short at the hips, tickled straight to short fine leg
Mowed over midwicket for another maaaaaaaaaasive blow! Half-tracker on middle, Nabi rocks into a back-foot pull
googly, sliding into middle, whisked away to the right of long-on
down the track and worked through midwicket
back of a length on middle, this slider is hauled away to long-on
Oh hello! President. He steps out to Tewatia, gets closer to the pitch and whacks a six over the spinner's head. Towering six
on a length and spins away outside off, punched down to long-on
very full on middle and leg, whipped away to the right of deep square leg. Parag runs around, bends lazily, and gives up four

Holes out to Morris at deep midwicket. First wicket for Tyagi in IPL 2021 and he has taken out Williamson. Slower short ball into the pitch and the line is outside off. The pull was on, but Williamson hits it straight to the outfielder
Williamson shuffles outside leg once again, full and sprayed down leg, glanced away fine leg of long leg for four. Williamson finally gets his strike rate up to 100
slower bouncer outside off, Williamson shifts outside leg and doesn't meet with a ramp
fullish and outside off, helped to deep third man
full and zipping in just a shade outside off, played back to Tyagi
worked through the vacant spaces at midwicket
back of a length and flat on middle, Williamson goes back and pulls to deep square leg
back of a length and sliding into off stump, whipped off the back foot to wide long-on
flighted on middle, Jadhav charges down the track, gets closer to the pitch, and lifts it over long-on for six
flighted and spins away outside off, Williamson slices a drive to point and scampers across to the other end
on a length and outside off, this legbreak is bunted down the ground to long-n
on the fuller side of a good length, clipped through square leg with the incoming angle
full and swerving down the leg side for a wide
he shimmies out at Morris, bumper, wide called for height
full on the stumps, whisked down to long-on
Miller runs in from long-on and takes this skier. Banged into the pitch and outside off, offcutter from Morris. Vijay rocks into a back-foot pull and splices it to another South African - Miller
Sakariya drops an overhead catch. He leaps at straight midwicket, but the ball bursts out of his hands. Slower short ball, aerial pull from Williamson and he gets a life
slower ball, pushed wide of off, slapped away to sweeper cover off the back foot
back of a length and angling into off, whipped away to straight midwicket
short legbreak, wide of off, Vijay misses a scoring opportunity, cutting straight to point off the back foot
looped up outside off and spins away, Williamson plays so very late, dabbing it to short third man
flat and quick, angling into the pads, shovelled away to deep midwicket
sliding down the leg side with fine leg inside the circle. Vijay directs it away fine of that infielder for four
down the track ad driven down to wide long-on
tossed up outside off, whisked away to long-on
low full-toss, dips at leg stump, draws a leading-edged waft to cover
Sakariya cuts his pace outside off, offcutter which beats Vijay outside off
full and angling across off, Williamson throws his bat at a drive and inside-edges it to short fine leg
slower cutter outside off, Vijay waits for it to come to him outside off, then dabs it down to deep third man
back of a length and angling away outside off, Williamson gets on top of the bounce and punches down to long-on
pitched up and outside off, slower ball, Williamson delays the drive and strokes it to extra-cover

Caught by debutant Anuj Rawat at long-on. Slower legbreak from Tewatia, spins away from Bairstow. Flat and shapes away from the batter, who gets into a sweeping position and ends up dragging the ball to Rawat who is a keeper at Delhi
another slider from Tewatia, whipped to deep midwicket off the back foot
back of a length and sliding into middle, Bairstow jumps back and heaves it away to deep midwicket
dragged down on leg stump with fine leg inside the circle. You know the result: helped away past the left of that infielder for four
quicker wrong'un, which is worked through square leg by Williamson
shortish and slipping down the leg side, Williamson tickles a sweep fine past the left of Samson
fuller around off, comes forward and guides it towards point
slower one, fuller outside off, pushes it towards cover region
length ball on the stumps, tucked away towards square leg
another slower and he bamboozles Williamson this time. Or maybe not. On a length and leaving the batter. Williamson was looking to open the face of the bat, just manages to work it past the keeper
fuller, way outside off. Left alone
looked like another cutter. On a length but way, way outside leg
bowled 'im! Was a slower one from Mustafizur. On the fuller side around middle and leg, Pandey went for the flick but ended up playing early. The ball hit the pads before disturbing the stumps
an attempted yorker, Pandey takes it on the full and hits it towards mid-on. They sprint across for a quick single
short of length outside off, backs away and pulls it in front of square leg. Tewatia is patrolling in that region, he puts in the slide but the cannot stop the ball
in the blockhole, Pandey digs it out wide of mid-on. In the gap and that's a four. 50 comes up for Sunrisers
length ball on the stumps, flicked towards deep midwicket
similar length but much straighter. Pandey backs away and drags it towards mid-on
starts with a short of a length delivery, outside off. Pandey flat-bats it towards extra cover
short of length outside off, Bairstow drops his gloves and lets it go
off-stump yorker, jammed past the bowler
mowed over midwicket for six! 142ks, short and angling into middle, the ball comes onto the bat. Pandey reads the length early and pulls it firmly
back of a length and angling into off stump, Pandey sits back and pulls to Jaiswal who fumbles
off-side wide
much fuller and wide of off, Pandey plants his front leg and finds his timing. He lets his hands flow through the line. Lofted over extra-cover for six
on a length and outside off, Pandey is struggling for timing, hauled to mid-on off the inner half
slower ball hung up outside off, Bairstow checks his drive and slices this 112.1ks ball to backward point
Pandey meets this shortish ball outside off with an open bat-face and steers to sweeper cover
on a heavy length and outside off, stabbed only as far as cover
shorter and angling across off stump, Bairstow latches onto the width and flays it through cover-point
Skied over Buttler for four. He runs back, gets into a side-on position, dives, but the ball bobbles out of his right hand. On a length and angling away around off, Bairstow miscues it and gets away
pumped over mid-off for six. Full and angling across off, no swing, Bairstow plants his front leg and drives through the line
very full and middle and leg, whipped to Morris at midwicket. He has a shy at the stumps and they pick up a single off the ricochet
slightly back of a length and outside off at 140ks. Bairstow has a roundhouse swipe to the leg side and misses
overpitched and outside off, smeared away to the right of mid-off off the front foot
bumper outside off, Bairstow ramps and misses. Thuds into the gloves of Samson
wide yorker, jammed out to mid-on off the inner half
thrashed to sweeper cover. Full and wide of off at 143.4ks
whippy cutter, dips on middle, tip and run to cover-point
on the pads, Mustafizur gets away with it. Pandey does not make contact with a leg-side flick and instead weakly deflects the ball to square leg
another cutter, on a back of a length, Bairstow manipulates a single between short third man and backward point
slower offcutter, dips outside off, takes the outside edge before bouncing in front of short third man
on a length and sliding across off, pushed up to mid-off
creamed between extra-cover and mid-off. Overpitched and outside off, Bairstow leans into a cover-drive and dispatches it
back of a length and outside off, Pandey stays leg-side of the ball and stabs it out in front of square on the off side
lifter, keeps coming into Pandey. The batter leans back, takes his eyes off the ball, and ends up spooning it over the keeper's head
short and angling into off at 144ks, fended back to the bowler
much fuller and flung wide of off at 144ks, Pandey swishes and doesn't touch it
pitched up and angling into off, 144ks, drilled back to Tyagi
back of a length, angling in towards off and kicks away past the shoulder of the bat. Samson leaps to his left to collect the ball
